confirmed_claims.proposition: Between 21:32:11 and 22:47:12 on 2025-05-16 a bulk copy operation moved 1,847 files from D:/projects/phoenix-client (1,633 files) and D:/clients (214 files) to E:/personal_backup on the workstation.
The corporate cloud-sync client was manually suspended at 21:30:02 and manually resumed at 22:50:11 on 2025-05-16, bracketing the bulk copy window.
Ticket HD-2025-0412 approved backing up only D:/projects/phoenix-client to a personal drive, expressly excluding all other directories.
The IT policy designates D:/clients and its descendants as managed client data that must not be copied to unregistered personal media, and requires ticket-scoped approval for backups.
The 214-file copy of D:/clients to the personal drive exceeded the granted backup authorization.
confirmed_claims.notes: inferential synthesis of log + policy + ticket + managed-share index

confirmed_claims.proposition: 周凯's last working day was 2025-05-23 and the workstation was returned to IT on that date — seven days after the copy operation.
